none: PAS CAM-E25896: Roman Coin : Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantius II as Augustus , 337-361. Mint id Trier, 340-341, Reece period 17. Obverse shows rosette-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]STANTI-VS PF AVG. Reverse shows two soldiers, one standard. Reverse type shows GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse fields and exergue read -//TRPV?(crescent?).
